title: Reliable Transcript Cleaning workflow
description: Make Transcript Cleaning provider-backed, chunked, resumable, fail-closed, idempotent, and review-gated without changing downstream workflow behavior.
businessContext: Long ASR transcripts currently time out or are persisted as misleading clean output, which blocks approved downstream segmentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Transcript Cleaning sends the cleaning prompt with bounded chunk requests and stores the model output; provider failure never creates a cleaning artifact.
Empty, malformed, wrapped-invalid, identical, or insufficiently changed model output fails with a safe error and preserves raw input only as run metadata.
Each reference has at most one active cleaning run for an input fingerprint; retries are bounded, exponential, idempotent, and resumable from the failed chunk.
Persisted run progress exposes completed/total chunks and the review artifact contains raw transcript, cleaned transcript, removed segments, flagged/sponsor terms, and execution metadata.
Reference Segmentation remains runnable only after all included references have approved cleaning artifacts.
Focused tests cover output validation, timeout, retry, duplicate run, empty output, unchanged output, parser errors, and ordered merge.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/transcriptCleaningService.test.ts packages/providers/test/nineRouter.test.ts packages/domain/test/ipcSchemas.test.ts packages/db/test/persistence.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: The provider cannot support bounded/idempotent text requests without changing external configuration.
A fix would require changing Reference Segmentation or another downstream workflow.
